title: Lobotomy Sound
blurb: The internet's off-switch, rendered as audio. The lobotomy meme is about declining to process reality on purpose: you hear the news, and you choose not to let any of it in. Dark enough that everybody laughs slightly guiltily. It turns up when somebody watches one brainrot video more than was advisable, or hits the thousand-yard stare halfway through a conversation they agreed to have. Reach for it when the alternative is engaging with something you have already decided is beyond you. Blissful emptiness, selected deliberately over comprehension.
origin: From the 'lobotomy' meme genre: choosing empty-headed bliss over reality.
